instructions:
Each item is an ontology term that a column of sample metadata in a gene
expression study can mean. Write up to 5 aliases for each term: other ways a
researcher would write that same variable as a column header in sample
metadata.

Good aliases:
- common abbreviations and acronyms ("sbp" for systolic blood pressure)
- shorter everyday phrasings ("systolic bp", "visual acuity")
- the plain name of the quantity when the term's label is wordy
  ("intraocular pressure" for "intraocular pressure measurement")

Rules:
- An alias must mean the same variable as the term: not a broader or narrower
  one, and not a related one.
- No values ("male", "high"), units on their own, gene or tool names, or
  dataset-specific codes.
- No alias that only rewords the label trivially (plural, case,
  punctuation). Those are matched already.
- Fewer is better than wrong. If a term has no natural alias, return an empty
  list.

Examples:
- systolic blood pressure -> ["sbp", "systolic bp", "systolic pressure"]
- intraocular pressure measurement -> ["intraocular pressure", "iop"]
- visual acuity measurement -> ["visual acuity", "va"]

items.label: Myeloid to Erythroid Ratio Measurement
items.definition: The determination of the ratio of myeloid cells compared to erythroid cells present in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage. [ NCI ]

items.label: Neutrophilic Metamyelocyte Count
items.definition: The determination of the number of neutrophilic metamyelocytes in a blood sample. [ NCI ]

items.label: Neutrophilic Myelocyte Count
items.definition: The determination of the number of neutrophilic myelocytes in a blood sample. [ NCI ]

items.label: Neutrophils Band Form to Neutrophils Ratio Measurement
items.definition: The determination of the ratio of neutrophil band form compared to neutrophils present in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage. [ NCI]

items.label: Ovalocyte Count
items.definition: The determination of the amount of ovalocytes present in a sample. [ NCI ]

items.label: Plasma Cell Count
items.definition: The determination of the amount of plasma cells present in a sample. [ NCI ]

items.label: Rubricyte Count
items.definition: The determination of the amount of rubricytes present in a sample. [ NCI ]

items.label: Segmented Neutrophils to Neutrophils Ratio Measurement
items.definition: The determination of the ratio of segmented neutrophils compared to neutrophils present in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage. [NCI ]

items.label: standard deviation of the normal-to-normal inter beat intervals
items.definition: Quantification of the intervals between normal heartbeats, expressed as standard deviation.

items.label: root mean square of the successive differences of inter beat intervals
items.definition: Quantification of the differences in intervals between heartbeats, expressed as root mean square.

items.label: peak-valley respiratory sinus arrhythmia or high frequency power
items.definition: Quantification of some aspects of sinus arrhythmia or high frequency power.

items.label: nicotine dependence symptom count
items.definition: Quantification of symptom associated with nicotine dependence.

items.label: nicotine withdrawal symptom count
items.definition: Quantification of symptom associated with nicotine withdrawal.

items.label: nausea and vomiting of pregnancy severity measurement
family history of Alzheimer’s disease
items.definition: A reported family history of Alzheimer’s disease in one or more family members.

items.label: heel bone mineral density
items.definition: Quantification of the mineral density of the heel bone

items.label: Epstein Barr virus nuclear antigen-1 seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Epstein Barr virus nuclear antigen-1 antibodies used in the diagnosis of latent Epstein-Barr virus infection

items.label: Epstein Barr viral capsid antigen seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Epstein Barr viral capsid antigen antibodies used in the diagnosis of Epstein-Barr virus infection

items.label: choroidal thickness measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the thickness of the choroid, the vascular layer of the eye lying between the retina and the sclera.

items.label: sodium measurement
items.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of sodium present in a sample.

items.label: potassium measurement
items.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of potassium present in a sample.

items.label: fructosamine measurement
items.definition: Quantification of levels of fructosamine present in a sample.

items.label: percent glycated albumin
items.definition: Quantification of the percentage of serum albumin in a sample that is glycated.

items.label: total glycated albumin
items.definition: Quantification of the total amount of glycated albumin in a sample.

items.label: atazanavir measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the total amount of atazanavir, typically assayed in hair. This is used as a measure of exposure to the drug.

items.label: glycated albumin measurement
items.definition: The determination of the amount of glycated albumin related peptide present in a biological specimen.

items.label: APOL1 risk genotype carrier status
items.definition: Quantification of the presence of absence of the APOL1 risk genotype in an individual

items.label: Chlamydia trachomatis seropositivity
items.definition: Chlamydia trachomatis seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating C. trachomatis specific antibodies

items.label: white matter growth measurement
items.definition: Quantification of any aspect of growth of the white matter during development

items.label: Epstein-Barr virus early antigen seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Epstein-Barr virus early antigen-specific antibodies

items.label: Herpes simplex virus 2 seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Herpes simplex virus 2-specific antibodies

items.label: Varicella zoster virus seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Varicella zoster virus-specific antibodies

items.label: Helicobacter pylori seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Helicobacter pylori-specific antibodies

items.label: Measles virus seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Measles virus-specific antibodies

items.label: Mumps virus seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Mumps virus-specific antibodies

items.label: Rubella virus seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Rubella virus-specific antibodies

items.label: Hepatitis B virus surface antigen seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Hepatitis B virus surface antigen-specific antibodies

items.label: Hepatitis B virus core antigen seropositivity
items.definition: The result of a measurement of circulating Hepatitis B virus core antigen-specific antibodies

items.label: Anti-influenza A virus IgG measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the IgG antibody isotype produced in response to influenza A virus infection

items.label: nicotine withdrawal measurement
items.definition: Quantification of measure of nicotine withdrwawal.

items.label: diffusing capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide
items.definition: A measurement of carbon monoxide (CO) transfer from inspired gas to pulmonary capillary blood. During the test, the subject inspires a gas containing CO and one or more tracer gases to allow determination of the gas exchanging capability of the lungs.
synonyms: transfer factor of the lung for carbon monoxide

items.label: radon exposure measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of exposure to radon gas

items.label: energy intake measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the energy intake of an individual, e.g. based on a food frequency questionnaire or seven-day food record and assessment of the calorific content of the food types and portion sizes recorded.

items.label: uterine fibroid measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of uterine fibroids, such as the number, volume or dimensions.

items.label: necrosis
items.definition: The phenotypic observation that death has occurred in groups of cells or in one or more tissues due to external factors, such as infection, toxins, mechanical trauma, loss of blood supply and other injuries (e.g. corrosion or burning). At the cellular level, morphological changes following necrosis

items.label: embryonic lethality
items.definition: Death of an embryo (human or animal) within the embryonic period prior to organogenesis. In mouse, this is defined as prior to E14.

items.label: synthetic lethality
items.definition: Death arising when a combination of deficiencies in the expression of two or more genes leads to cell death, whereas a deficiency in only one of these genes does not.

items.label: arthritis disease activity score measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the global severity of rheumatoid arthritis in a patient, based on a combination of several different specific measures, e.g. swollen 28-joint count, tender 28-joint count, erythrocyte sedimentation rate and patient global health assessment score.

items.label: offspring survival measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the ability of an individual's offspring to survive or live successfully, e.g. the number of children surviving to a given age.

items.label: offspring mortality measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of the death of an individual's offspring, e.g. the number of children dying before a given age.

items.label: number of pregnancies measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the number of pregnancies a woman has

items.label: multiple births measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of multiple births, eg the number or proportion born to an individual.

items.label: age at last pregnancy measurement
items.definition: A measurement of the age at which a woman became pregnant for the final time in her reproductive life.

items.label: hypoxia
items.definition: A decrease in the amount of oxygen in the body. Symptoms range from mild (impaired judgment, memory loss, impaired motor coordination) to severe (seizures and coma). [ NCI ]

items.label: infarction
items.definition: A localised pathological necrosis of tissue resulting from obstruction of the blood supply usually by a thrombus, an embolus, or vascular torsion.

items.label: hemolysis
items.definition: Disruption of the integrity of the erythrocyte membrane causing release of hemoglobin. [ NCI ]

items.label: neck injury
items.definition: Damage inflicted to the neck.

items.label: eye injury
items.definition: Damage inflicted to an eye.

items.label: abdominal injury
items.definition: Injury to the abdomen.

items.label: caustic injury
items.definition: Tissue corrosion or chemical burn. Chemical burns are injuries to the skin, eyes, mouth, or internal organs caused by contact with a corrosive substance

items.label: crush injury
items.definition: Traumatic compression of the body or a part of the body. [ NCI ]

items.label: head injury
items.definition: Injury to the head.

items.label: heart injury
items.definition: Injury to the heart.

items.label: leg injury
items.definition: Injury to a leg.

items.label: limb injury
items.definition: Injury to a limb.

items.label: abnormal PAP smear
items.definition: A finding indicating the presence of abnormal cervical cells in a PAP smear. [ NCI ]

items.label: lower extremity fracture
items.definition: A traumatic break in one or more of the bones in the hip, thigh, leg, or foot. [ NCI ]

items.label: multiple bone fractures
items.definition: Two or more simultaneous traumatic breaks in one or more bones. [ NCI ]

items.label: upper extremity fracture
items.definition: A traumatic break in one or more of the bones in the arm, forearm, or hand. [ NCI ]

items.label: burn
items.definition: A traumatic injury involving interruption of tissue cohesiveness that results from exposure to caustic chemicals, extreme heat, extreme cold or excessive radiation. [ NCI ]

items.label: dislocation
items.definition: A displacement of a part (especially a bone) from its normal position. [ NCI ]

items.label: foreign body
items.definition: Extraneous material within the body. [ NCI ]

items.label: frostbite
items.definition: An injury to the skin and/or its underlying tissues that results from exposure of the affected area to extreme cold. [ NCI ]

items.label: sprain
items.definition: A stretching or tearing of a ligament. [ NCI ]

items.label: place of residence measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of an individual's place of residence, such as population density or socioeconomic status.

items.label: verbal memory measurement
items.definition: Quantification of an individual's ability to store and recall linguistic information.

items.label: thyroid radioablation therapy
items.definition: Therapy using radioactive iodine for ablation of remnant thyroid tissue following a complete thyroidectomy to treat thyroid cancer.

items.label: stroke outcome severity measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the the degree of disability or dependence in the daily activities of people who have suffered a stroke, for example using the Modified Rankin Scale.

items.label: clavicle fracture
items.definition: A traumatic or pathologic injury to the clavicle in which the continuity of the clavicle is broken. [ NCI ]

items.label: rib fracture
items.definition: A traumatic or pathologic injury to the rib in which the continuity of the rib is broken. [ NCI ]

items.label: shoulder fracture
items.definition: A traumatic break in one or more of the bones that compose the shoulder joint. [ NCI ]

items.label: fracture of pelvis
items.definition: A traumatic break in one or more of the bones that compose the bony structure of the pelvis. [ NCI ]

items.label: nose injury
items.definition: Trauma to the nose. [ NCI ]

items.label: abnormal result of function studies
items.definition: Abnormal result of a test meant to evaluate functionality of an organ or system, such as electroencephalogram, electrocardiogram, glucose tolerance test and others.

items.label: event
items.definition: Something that happens at a given place and time. [ NCI ]

items.label: convalescence
items.definition: A processual entity during which a patient participating in a disease course gradually returns to participating in a canonical life course.

items.label: fall
items.definition: A sudden movement downward, usually resulting in injury. [ NCI ]

items.label: tissue donor
items.definition: Someone who gives tissue to be used in another person. [ NCI ]

items.label: organ donor
items.definition: Someone from whom an organ is removed for transplantation or other purpose. [ NCI ]

items.label: blood donor
items.definition: Someone from whom blood is removed for transfusion or other purpose. [ NCI ]

items.label: spontaneous labor and birth
items.definition: Initiation of labor without the use of pharmacological and/or mechanical interventions, resulting in a non-operative vaginal birth. [NCIT]

items.label: Braxton-Hicks contractions
items.definition: Irregular infrequent uterine contractions typically characteristic of the third trimester of pregnancy that do not result in cervical change or labor. [def-source: NCI][attr: NICHD]

items.label: family history of cancer
items.definition: A form of clinicaly history specifically about cancer in family members.

items.label: malaise
items.definition: A feeling of general discomfort or uneasiness, an out-of-sorts feeling. [def-source: NCI][attr: CDC Glossary]

items.label: thiopurine metabolite measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the metabolites of thiopurine compounds.

items.label: beta-lactam allergy measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the presence or severity of an allergy to beta-lactam, including beta-lactam antibiotics.

items.label: household income
items.definition: A demographic parameter indicating the amount of earning made by a family.

items.label: social deprivation
items.definition: Absence of social environment which is necessary for the social development of the individual.

items.label: pathological complete response
items.definition: The disappearance of all signs of cancer, supported by pathological examination.

items.label: visceral:total adipose tissue ratio
items.definition: Quantification of visceral to total adipose tissue.
